scripts.build:browser-host: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @intelligence/collector-browser-host
scripts.typecheck:browser-host: npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @intelligence/collector-browser-host
scripts.verify:browser-host: npm run build:browser-host && npm run build:extension && npm run verify:lifecycle --workspace @intelligence/collector-browser-host
scripts.build:collector-runtime: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:extension && npm run build --workspace @intelligence/collector-browser-host && npm run build --workspace @intelligence/collector-gateway
scripts.build:user-browser-runtime: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:extension && npm run build:user-browser --workspace @intelligence/collector-gateway
scripts.prepare:user-browser-deployment: npm run build:user-browser-runtime && npm run prepare:user-browser-extension --workspace @intelligence/collector-gateway --
scripts.update:user-browser-deployment: npm run build:user-browser-runtime && npm run prepare:user-browser-extension --workspace @intelligence/collector-gateway -- --replace
scripts.start:user-browser: npm run build:user-browser-runtime && npm run start:user-browser --workspace @intelligence/collector-gateway
scripts.test:unit: npm run verify:core-boundaries && npm run verify:core-capability-matrix && npm run test:typecheck && npm run test:client && vitest run --project governance --project contracts --project extension-domain --project browser-host-domain --project gateway-domain
scripts.test:unit:coverage: npm run test:typecheck && vitest run --project governance --project contracts --project extension-domain --project browser-host-domain --project gateway-domain --coverage
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:collector-runtime && playwright test --config playwright.real-local.config.ts --project integration
scripts.test:e2e:local: npm run build:collector-runtime && playwright test --config playwright.real-local.config.ts --project e2e-local
scripts.test:real-local: npm run build:collector-runtime && playwright test --config playwright.real-local.config.ts --project integration --project e2e-local
scripts.test:all-local: npm run test:unit && npm run test:real-local
scripts.verify:collector: npm run test:all-local && npm run verify:local -- --skip-playwright-owned
